hypothesis: CCM's RH strategy rests on: (step a, their Section 8) the truncated Weil quadratic form QW^{lambda,N} has a SIMPLE smallest eigenvalue with EVEN eigenvector xi_lambda; (step b) xi_lambda is approximated by the prolate 'educated guess' k_lambda built from Riemann's exact two-Hermite-mode formula (their 7.1/7.4), so that det_reg(D_log^{(lambda,N)} - z) -> (scalar) Xi(z) and the spectra of the self-adjoint rank-one perturbations D_log^{(lambda,N)} converge to the zeta zeros -- which 'would establish RH' via Hurwitz. THE QUESTION: is this ground-state/spectral mechanism an S1 separator (consumes arithmetic input Davenport-Heilbronn lookalikes fail), arithmetic-blind (DH passes the same tests), or a separator via the quantitative collapse RATE of the ground eigenvalue?

experiment_summary.construction: QW^{lambda,N} built exactly per arXiv:2511.22755: basis V_n = kappa(U_n) (their 2.6/3.21), q(U_j,U_k) per Lemma 2.3, tau_{jk} = archimedean term (log-side representation validated against the spectral t-integral AND the paper's (3.15) form) + W_{0,2} pole term (zeta only) - sum_{1<n<=lambda^2} Lambda(n) n^{-1/2} q(log n). Parity split into even/odd sectors (their gamma-grading, Lemma 5.1); ground state and gaps per Definition 5.3; D'' spectrum from the ground eigenvector via Theorem 5.10 root equation sum_j xi_j/(j - s') = 0.

interpretation: Every phenomenon the CCM paper exhibits for zeta, and everything their Section 8 missing step (a) asserts, is reproduced mutatis mutandis by the RH-violating Davenport-Heilbronn function fed through the identical construction: positivity in range, simple even ground state, prolate-shaped ground vector, margin collapsing on the conductor-rescaled Fuchs law, self-adjoint D'' whose spectrum matches the function's own low on-line zeros with accuracy set by the margin. The spectacular zeta-vs-DH rate gap flagged at Session-4 close (4.2e-38 vs 7.6e-7 at lambda=3) is real but is a CONDUCTOR effect, not an arithmetic one: the same-conductor RH-true control chi5 collapses at DH's rate (c ratio 0.976), and the four fitted rates line up on c = 4*pi/q_cond (the prolate bandwidth parameter gamma = 2*pi*lambda^2 rescaled by the conductor) -- with zeta merely the q=1 endpoint. The 'striking numerical accuracy' of the low-zero match, including CCM's 1e-1235 improbability rhetoric, is therefore explicit-formula bookkeeping available to ANY functional-equation lookalike: its precision measures the archimedean data (conductor), not the Euler product. CCM's own indication (1) for step (a) -- that even-simple holds for the prolate operator PW_lambda for all lambda -- already signals that step (a) is a harmonic-analysis fact; our experiment confirms it is arithmetic-blind empirically. The Fuchs fit SUPPORTS CCM's internal mechanism claim (their Fig 4: eps_lambda tracks 1-chi(lambda); we get a bounded ratio 7-14 over 25 orders) -- but this very success is what shows the margin law is prolate/archimedean, hence blind. Where must arithmetic enter? By their own Hurwitz argument, uniform convergence of xihat_lambda to Xi_DH on strips is IMPOSSIBLE for DH (real-zero functions cannot converge uniformly to a function with zeros off the real axis at z = 85.7 +/- 0.3085i), so any rigorous proof of the CCM convergence conjecture must break for DH exactly at the limit statement. Nothing in the paper's scaffolding, and nothing measurable at accessible truncations, discharges that burden: the S1-separating content of the framework is deferred entirely to the unproven conjecture, whose content at that point is classical Weil positivity for all supports (= RH) in new packaging. The DH form must in fact crash to indefiniteness at some finite support; a resolution estimate (frequency resolution pi/log(lambda) finer than the mean zero gap ~1.3 at t~86) puts that onset near mu = lambda^2 ~ 120+, where the conductor law would have eps_DH ~ 1e-130: the arithmetic-visible event lies far beyond both our range (mu <= 14.44) and CCM's own numerics (mu <= 17, N = 120). CAVEAT on scope: this verdict concerns the mechanism AS PROBED (finite truncations, four coefficient systems); it does not refute the CCM convergence conjecture for zeta, which remains consistent with all data here.

verdict_statement: The CCM ground-state/spectral mechanism, as probeable at finite truncation, is arithmetic-blind: Davenport-Heilbronn passes the even-simple test, supports the identical self-adjoint construction, has its own low zeros reproduced by the D'' spectrum, and its ground-eigenvalue collapse obeys the same conductor-rescaled prolate/Fuchs law as RH-true Euler-product controls (c = 4*pi/q; DH vs same-conductor chi5 rates agree to 2.4%). The collapse RATE is therefore NOT a separator either -- it measures the conductor, not the Euler product (the 'separator-via-collapse-rate' reading suggested by the raw Session-4 numbers is refuted by the chi5 control). The mechanism cannot underwrite a full-RH route by itself: all S1 content is deferred to the unproven convergence conjecture, whose failure for DH (mandatory, by Hurwitz) only becomes spectrally visible at truncation scales (mu >~ 120) far beyond both our and CCM's numerics.
confidence_rationale: For: blindness demonstrated across four coefficient systems and 10-14 support values each; every load-bearing number independently re-verified per standing order 5; conventions triple-validated against the paper. Against (residual 0.15): rate constants are finite-mu fits (3-6% from asymptotes); prefactor-level arithmetic signatures not fully excluded; untested corners of the CCM construction (det_reg normalization constants, the delta_N Dirichlet-kernel pairing) could conceivably carry arithmetic sensitivity; verdict is about the probed mechanism, and a rigorous proof of their conjecture could still exist that consumes Euler input invisibly to numerics.

implications.ncg_berry_keating_shortlist_item: The sweep's 'only immediately executable decisive test' is now executed and it decides AGAINST commissioning an NCG direction premised on the CCM spectral mechanism supplying S1. CCM should be reclassified from grossmann-candidate-adjacent to INSTRUMENT: superb calibrated machinery (finite-prime zero approximants of astonishing accuracy, the margin law, the prolate bridge) with the arithmetic IOU intact. Any ncg+berry-keating direction must import its S1 axiom from elsewhere -- e.g. the beyond-endoscopy monoid-form DH-exclusion theorem (grossmann-sweep2-partial) -- and use CCM machinery only as its computational/spectral arm.
implications.s1_axiom_of_de_novo_construction: Strong reinforcement of the campaign post-mortem and hard-constraints section: spectral realization, self-adjointness, and small-support Weil positivity are S1-EMPTY -- at finite truncation ALL Weil-form phenomena are conductor-universal, so a DH-filter applied at the phenomena level cannot certify S1. The de-novo S1 axiom must consume input structurally ABSENT for DH at the axiom level (intact Euler product / monoid structure; Lambda(n) >= 0 pointwise -- note Lambda_DH(12) = -0.76 < 0 is a one-line witness; Rankin-Selberg nonnegativity). New quantitative instrument: the conductor-Fuchs law eps ~ poly * e^{-4*pi*mu/q} is the RH-true baseline for Weil-form margins; a candidate mechanism exhibits S1 content precisely to the extent its DH run DEPARTS from this baseline at accessible depth. Our experiment supplies the calibrated baseline.
implications.ccm_convergence_conjecture_dh_defense: The conjecture does NOT currently inherit a DH-filter defense. Its entire numerical evidence base (even-simple, low-zero matching, margin law, det_reg structure) is reproduced by DH at conductor scale, so that evidence cannot be evidence FOR the arithmetic-specific part of the conjecture. The conjecture is not refuted -- zeta's eps/(1-chi) ratio staying bounded (7 to 14) over 25 orders is genuinely consistent with their k_lambda ~ xi_lambda claim -- but any proof must locate a step that fails for DH, and the only such step currently identifiable is the conclusion itself (uniform strip convergence to an all-real-zero limit), i.e. Weil positivity at all supports = RH. Note their step (b) scaffold (Riemann's exact two-Hermite-mode formula 7.1) has a natural DH analogue at conductor scale sqrt(5) via the odd theta series of the conjugate characters mod 5 (assessment, not verified numerically), so even Lemma 7.1-type structure is unlikely to be the filter.
